title: IPU Lab
text: How do we infer others’ traits and mental states such as their thoughts and feelings? We study the accuracy and biases of these inferences, what shapes them (e.g., the cues available, characteristics of perceivers and targets, communication context), the social-cognitive mechanisms behind them, and their consequences.

title: IPU Lab
text:
Interpersonal Understanding
What happens when we try to see the world through someone else’s eyes? We study when and why people take others’ perspectives, how well they succeed, and how doing so shapes downstream outcomes such as moral judgments and prosocial behavior. We are also interested in the limits of perspective taking and in ways to help people understand one another better.

title: Welcome to the IPU Lab
text:
The Interpersonal Perception & Understanding (IPU) Lab has launched in the Department of Psychology at Bilkent University. We study how people see and understand one another, and how screens and AI are changing that.
Take a look at our research, and stay tuned for updates.

title: IPU Lab

Interested in joining the lab?


Starting Spring 2027

Undergraduate research assistants
We are looking for undergraduate research assistants to join the lab in Spring 2027! Research assistants help run studies, conduct literature reviews, code and manage data, and take part in lab meetings. If you are interested in gaining research experience and seeing how social psychology research is done from the inside, we would love to hear from you.
Contact



Starting Fall 2027

Graduate students
The IPU lab will be accepting graduate students to start in Fall 2027. Students receive hands-on training in study designs, advanced statistical methods, and open-science practices, and are involved in every stage of the research process. If you are interested in how people perceive and understand one another, consider applying to the graduate program in the Department of Psychology at Bilkent University!

title: People
text:
The IPU Lab is a new and growing group at Bilkent University.



Principal Investigator





Murat Kezer

Murat is an assistant professor in the Department of Psychology at Bilkent University. His research broadly examines how we perceive and understand others. His research uses dyadic designs, experimental methods, computational techniques, and large language models.
